# 'bolero get pkg' should not upgrade to a retracted version.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
bolero mod edit -require example.com/retract/self/prev@v1.1.0
bolero get example.com/retract/self/prev
bolero list -m example.com/retract/self/prev
stdout '^example.com/retract/self/prev v1.1.0$'

# 'bolero get pkg' should not downgrade from a retracted version when no higher
# version is available.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
bolero mod edit -require example.com/retract/self/prev@v1.9.0
bolero get example.com/retract/self/prev
stderr '^bolero: warning: example.com/retract/self/prev@v1.9.0: retracted by module author: self$'
stderr '^bolero: to switch to the latest unretracted version, run:\n\tbolero get example.com/retract/self/prev@latest\n$'
bolero list -m example.com/retract/self/prev
stdout '^example.com/retract/self/prev v1.9.0$'

# 'bolero get pkg@latest' should downgrade from a retracted version.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
bolero mod edit -require example.com/retract/self/prev@v1.9.0
bolero get example.com/retract/self/prev@latest
bolero list -m example.com/retract/self/prev
stdout '^example.com/retract/self/prev v1.1.0$'

# 'bolero get pkg@version' should update to a specific version, even if that
# version is retracted.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
bolero get example.com/retract@v1.0.0-bad
stderr '^bolero: warning: example.com/retract@v1.0.0-bad: retracted by module author: bad$'
bolero list -m example.com/retract
stdout '^example.com/retract v1.0.0-bad$'

# 'bolero get -u' should not downgrade from a retracted version when no higher
# version is available.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
bolero mod edit -require example.com/retract/self/prev@v1.9.0
bolero get -u ./use
stderr '^bolero: warning: example.com/retract/self/prev@v1.9.0: retracted by module author: self$'
bolero list -m example.com/retract/self/prev
stdout '^example.com/retract/self/prev v1.9.0$'

# 'bolero get' should warn if a module needed to build named packages is retracted.
# 'bolero get' should not warn about unrelated modules.
bolero get ./empty
! stderr retracted
bolero get ./use
stderr '^bolero: warning: example.com/retract/self/prev@v1.9.0: retracted by module author: self$'

-- go.mod.orig --
module example.com/use

go 1.15

-- use/use.go --
package use

import _ "example.com/retract/self/prev"
-- empty/empty.go --
package empty
